name: jairf-tech-budgets
description: JAIRF technical budgets & naming roadmap (per 05_Technical_Budgets_Naming.md). Poly budgets LOD0-3 per asset type (player 15-25k, boss 20-35k, enemy 8-15k, weapon 3-8k, builder piece 0.5-3k, prop 2-6k, tree 3-8k). Texture budgets (2K hero/1K normal/512-1K modular, atlasing, ASTC/DXT/BC). Performance targets: 60 FPS mid-range PC, draw call control, limited dynamic lights, particle soft caps, network interest management. Naming: SM_/SK_/M_/T_/PF_/A_/SFX_/MUS_/AMB_/UI_/SO_.

phases.name: 1. Poly budget table adoption (LOD0-3 per asset type)
3. Performance targets (FPS, draw calls, lights, particles, network)
4. Naming conventions for all asset families
5. Enforcement tooling: CI validation + agent build rules
